name: Doctor Boat Control Marine Intelligence V8.2
release_notes: Real Natural Earth vector world base map replaces the schematic demo map.
World base map opens automatically in AI Positioning System.
World map supports zoom, pan and right-click coordinate readout.
Global UTM zone grid overlays the world map.
S-57 ENC remains the real nautical vector overlay path in local UTM mode.
CM93 remains detected/indexed pending its dedicated decoder/renderer.
